remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST DEADLINE: Monday, Jan. 12 at NOON. New Year, New Home: This lovingly cared for home is ready to pass the torch to the next owner. Loved by the same family since it was built, this pristine, solidly built house offers a blank canvas to realize your dream home. The main level offers hardwood flooring throughout and an open floor plan between the living room and dining room. Sunlight pours into the three-season room - turn this into a four season room and this would make a wonderful reading nook. The three bedrooms are spacious and include large closets. Downstairs, the large family room opens to an additional three-season room offering plenty of room to play and relax. An extra room on the lower level offers the possibility of a home office, hobby room, or whatever suits your needs. Each room is zoned with its own heat source to maximize energy efficiency.  Easy to maintain, private backyard includes garden shed. This home is conveniently located on a cul-de-sac close to shopping, transportation and commuting routes. Roof approx. 2023, H/W heater approx. 2018. Make this home yours and start creating wonderful memories with family and friends.
